caption:
Hair and salon businesses often carry fit-out and equipment costs relative to their size, with revenue tied closely to appointment bookings and stylist capacity. Finance can support fit-out, additional chairs, or opening a second location.

Every industry has its own rhythm when it comes to cash flow and finance needs, understanding hair and salon businesses's specific pattern is the first step to finding the right fit.

Fit-out costs and appointment-driven revenue both shape how salon businesses plan their finances.
